prompt:
Edit paint_mask_guide.png exactly following this production brief. Input 1 is the edit target: the grey guide sheet. Input 2 design_reference.png is the material/detail reference only. Input 3 icon_x8.png is the colour reference only; magenta is background, never paint it.
Output ONE transparent PNG at 1536x2048 (or nearest 3:4 size). Preserve the guide's THREE columns and FOUR rows of equal square cells. Rows 1-2 and 3-4 show identical sets of five views, FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty. The view names are logical labels only: retain the actual unusual orientations in the guide exactly. Do not rotate any view. Every object must remain in exactly the guide position, size, outline and pose. Paint grey pixels only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign geometry. Preserve all gaps and holes as transparent. Empty cells column 3 row 2 and column 3 row 4 remain transparent.
Rows 1-2 PAINT: unlit base colour. Dark bronze and gold plate armour. Each shoulder guard a roaring golden lion head; sculpted gold-bronze breastplate with gold rivets, thin purple trim along edges and waist, dark bronze tasset plates edged in gold. Facets, engravings, scrollwork, inner swirls follow the design reference scaled to each view. No lighting, cast shadows, ambient occlusion, hot highlights, reflections, outlines, glow, sparkles, aura, ground or text.
Rows 3-4 MATERIAL MASK: identical five silhouettes filled only with FLAT PURE colours, no shading, texture, outlines, or antialiased colour blends inside: #FF0000 every metal part (steel iron chain mail gold silver bronze copper brass); #00FF00 leather straps padding hide suede fur; #0000FF cloth tabards quilting linings cords ribbons hair; #000000 gemstones crystal glass pearl enamel or liquid seen through glass. Every pixel inside each silhouette receives exactly one of those four colours, nothing outside. Metal plates and lion heads red; purple cloth trims blue. Preserve openings and background alpha.
This is a precise aligned projection painting atlas, not a redesigned illustration. Preserve the guide silhouettes and layout absolutely.
CORRECTIVE GENERATION: The previous attempt had stray red speckles outside the lower silhouettes and dark contour lines within material masks. Fix this. Background must be completely transparent, with absolutely no stray pixels. Match original guide silhouettes precisely in ALL ten objects including hollow collar openings. Material masks must be solid regions of exact pure red and blue (other listed colours only where relevant), WITHOUT black drawn contour/engraving lines. Metal engravings remain the same pure red as surrounding metal. Do not fill hollow openings. Retain exact original guide canvas proportions and positions.
